nexl-builder 1.0.0

- Initial release of Nexl Brand Site Generator.
- Enables creation of brand websites and aesthetic landing pages via a six-step framework.
- Features dual-role “Brand Broker x Site Builder” flow, with brand-profile initialization and accumulation.
- Introduces strict platform awareness, branded onboarding in Chinese and English, and transparent cost breakdown.
- Provides template-based site generation with design consistency enforced by an 8-dimension gate.
- Fully self-contained: no external files or network fetch required for deployment.
- Ready for use on WorkBuddy, Coze, Meoo, 百度智能体, Claude, Codex, and Cursor platforms.

Initial release of nexl-builder.

- Provides a self-contained Awwwards-grade interactive brand site & landing-page generator for various AI agent platforms.
- Adds dual Brand Broker/Site Builder flow with strict step-by-step onboarding, including brand archive creation and template injection.
- Ensures all output sites strictly follow a verified design skeleton with enforced variable replacement, micro-interactions, and modern design best practices.
- Integrates budget/cost transparency, platform-specific adaptation, and multi-language onboarding for global users.
- Introduces robust internal references for workflow (brand-profile, template-catalog, budget, code skeleton) within the package, requiring no external fetches.
- Removes outdated or redundant documentation; fully restructures and refines onboarding and usage description.
